numiaerobridge.ponder.docking_connector_: Selling items and fluids with SalePoints
Without a SalePoint bound, the connected pair keeps its normal item and fluid transfer behaviour.
Use a fresh SalePoint item and sneak-right-click the connector to switch between item and fluid sale modes.
Then right-click the connector with the SalePoint item to select it as the target.
While bound, incoming stock is held in the SalePoint buffer instead of being delivered directly.
After a successful payment, the purchased items or fluid are transferred into the opposite connector.
Removing the SalePoint releases the connector pair and restores normal transfer.
